integrity: The proof derives the exact error recurrence, tracks the leading nilpotent power and coefficient at every step, proves exact dyadic termination, and gives explicit spectral and Frobenius transient bounds. The three-dimensional equality case is exact. Finite verification replays representative identities but is not used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic theorem for the unscaled Newton matrix-sign iteration on scaled unipotent Jordan blocks. It does not give a global worst-case bound at fixed condition number or nonnormality, does not analyze scaled Newton variants, and does not quantify floating-point behavior.
title: Unipotent Newton matrix-sign iterates have exact dyadic termination but unbounded first-step transients
